parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

set firewall family inet filter ACL-3001.template: set firewall family inet filter [parameter1] term [parameter2] from source-address [parameter3]/[parameter4]

set firewall family inet filter ACL-3001.explanation: 配置防火墙过滤器的动作。

parameters.name: action

set interfaces ge-2/0/0 unit 0 family in.explanation: 配置接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: unit
